real_world_examples: How 'Interfaith Dialogue' shows up in real-world world religion practice: Examines the theory and practice of dialogue among religious traditions and the frameworks used to foster understanding.
How 'Religion and Human Rights' shows up in real-world world religion practice: Analyzes the relationship between religious traditions and modern conceptions of human rights and freedom of belief.
How 'Religion and the Environment' shows up in real-world world religion practice: Examines how religious traditions understand nature and contribute to environmental thought and activism.
World Religion.learning_path: At Undergraduate Year 4, World Religion progresses through Interfaith Dialogue, Religion and Human Rights, Religion and the Environment, Religion and Economics, Contemporary Islam, Contemporary Christianity, Buddhism in the Modern World, Religion and Media. Learners should complete modules in order, attempt the quiz after each module, and take the level exam once all modules are complete before advancing to the next level.
